rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Collection of MCP servers for managing Ubiquiti UniFi controllers covering Network (91 tools), Protect (34 tools), and Access (29 tools). Supports device management, firewall configuration, camera events, smart detections, door access control, and cross-product correlation through a cloud relay. All mutations use a preview-then-confirm flow.
